executive_summary: TechCorp's Information Security Policy Version 2.4 demonstrates an understanding of cryptographic standards, but it falls short in several areas, including stream cipher implementation, asymmetric key exchange, and hashing. The policy's use of hardcoded and reused Initialization Vectors (IVs) for stream ciphers is a significant security risk. Additionally, the policy's choice of RSA with a 2048-bit key length for web traffic in the Moderate zone is not in line with the recommended minimum key length of 3072 bits. The policy also incorrectly uses SHA-2 (SHA2-512/256) for the Advanced zone, which is not accepted for ADVANCED strength levels according to the National Cryptographic Standards.
compliant_areas: Use of AES with a 128-bit key length for standard data in the Moderate zone (Section 2.1.2 of the National Cryptographic Standards)
Use of Serpent with a 256-bit key for Advanced level storage (Section 2.1.2 of the National Cryptographic Standards)
Use of Elliptic Curve (ECC) based on NIST P-521 for key agreement in the Advanced zone (Section 2.2 of the National Cryptographic Standards)
violations: Hardcoding and reusing Initialization Vectors (IVs) for stream ciphers (Section 2.1.1 of the National Cryptographic Standards, which requires a unique IV for each key)

Using RSA with a 2048-bit key length for web traffic in the Moderate zone (Section 2.2 of the National Cryptographic Standards, which recommends a minimum key length of 3072 bits for MODERATE strength levels)
Using SHA-2 (SHA2-512/256) for the Advanced zone (Section 2.3 of the National Cryptographic Standards, which does not accept SHA-2 for ADVANCED strength levels)
Using SHAKE128 with an output size of 128 bits for lightweight hashing (Section 2.3 of the National Cryptographic Standards, which requires an output size of at least 256 bits for SHAKE128)
recommendations: Implement a secure random number generator to generate unique Initialization Vectors (IVs) for stream ciphers
Upgrade the RSA key length to at least 3072 bits for web traffic in the Moderate zone
Replace SHA-2 (SHA2-512/256) with SHA-3 (SHA3-512) for the Advanced zone
Increase the output size of SHAKE128 to at least 256 bits for lightweight hashing
